description: The spectrograms of a lane's clips on one canvas and one WebGL context, computed on the GPU at every zoom by gl-spectrogram through @audio-ui/gl, on the frequency axis of your choice (octaves, mel, ERB or hertz), with the frequency and level under the pointer and an axis of frequency labels for the lane. It draws only what the view shows, in the text colour over the ground under it, and nothing without WebGL 2.
name: clip-spectrogram
